items.label: HUNTER PATROL+
items.why: The whole game in one packed program: the cracker's loader and loading picture, then the engine, graphics, tables and music, which its unpacker expands to $0C00-$BFFF before the cracker's menu (work/entry.vsf is the hand-over); the listing is built from that memory. The loading picture (bitmap $E000, screen $DC00), which the unpacking overwrites, was read from memory while it was up and is drawn on graphics.html.

items.label: H.PATROL HI /REM
items.why: The highscore table the cracker's code writes: five scores of five digits and five names of twelve letters, loaded to $0C00 by the menu's L key and saved by $0C55 after a name is entered.
